title: Alexander_Y._Tetelbaum
summary:
Alexander Yakov Tetelbaum (born August 16, 1948, in Kyiv, Ukraine) is an educator, computer scientist, inventor, academician, entrepreneur, and novelist. He has been a pioneer in the Electronic Design Automation (EDA) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) industries since the 1960s.

Tetelbaum was Professor of Design Automation and a Distinguished Scientist at the National Technical University of Ukraine. In 1991, he founded and presided over the International Solomon University. He holds more than 50 US patents and is the author and co-author of 300 publications, including 20 books.

Dr. Tetelbaum led design methodology and automation teams in LSI, Silicon Graphics, SGI, and Zycad Corporations. He has served as a reviewer for the American Mathematical Society since 1994. He is a Fellow and Honorary Doctor of several universities, academies, and societies.

Prof Tetelbaum was selected for inclusion in Who's Who in the World, Men of Achievement, Who's Who in Technology, Who's Who in American Education, and other directories. WorldAtlas.com has included Dr. Tetelbaum as a Ukrainian famous native as an inventor and scientist. His last known position was President and CEO of Abelite Design Automation, Inc.
